vo: Markets never sleep. Gold, Bitcoin and the world's biggest stock indices move day and night. But you have a job, a family and a life. In the next five minutes, you'll see how FTM puts the markets to work for you, and exactly how it does it.

Here's the problem. Most people think taking part in the markets means watching charts all day. A nurse on a night shift can't. A pilot over the Atlantic can't. A banker in back-to-back meetings can't. And people who do try often trade on emotion. They buy in excitement, sell in fear, and miss the moves that matter. Time, stress and emotion. That's what keeps most people out.

FTM's answer is FTM MACHINE. It's smart software that trades for you by fixed rules, around the clock, five days a week. It doesn't get tired. It doesn't panic. It follows the same plan on Monday morning as it does on Friday night.

So how does it work? Your money stays in your own trading account, with your own broker, in your own name. FTM never holds it. You connect that account to FTM MACHINE, and it places the trades for you. The access it gets can place trades, but it can never withdraw your money. And you can pause it, or remove it, at any time.

FTM MACHINE trades five markets on one account: gold, Bitcoin, the US Tech 100, the dollar against the yen, and the Hang Seng 50. Spreading across five markets means one quiet market doesn't stop the day. Together, we call it the Portfolio.

You choose how much risk you're comfortable with. Conservative keeps exposure lower, for a steadier ride. Balanced is our default. And Growth two times is the most active profile, for people who accept bigger swings. You can change your profile whenever you like.

Now, the numbers. In FTM's backtest from 2020 to 2026, the Portfolio on Growth two times grew by ninety-eight thousand, six hundred and forty-four percent. Seven out of seven years ended in profit, and fifty-three of eighty-two months. The deepest drop along the way was thirty-nine percent, and we show you that too.

And today? Every evening at eleven p.m., we post the live result of the FTM master account: every trade, on good days and bad days. Look at November. There were red days, some of them big. And by the nineteenth, the month stood at plus eleven point five six percent.

Losing days happen in every kind of trading. What makes FTM different is that you see all of them. Your client area shows a calendar of every day, your statistics, your statements, and every single trade on your account, in fifty languages.

Three questions we hear every day. Can I take my money out? Yes, at any time, from your own broker account. FTM never touches it. What happens in a losing month? You see it in your calendar and statements, like every other month, and you decide whether to pause. And do I need experience? No. If you can use a phone, you can start.
